_source: NextGen E-Sports is a prototype club and this schedule is fictional. Venue coordinates are a real Kuala Lumpur location so the live forecast returns meaningful data.

events.title: Valorant Scrim Block
events.description: Structured scrim block for the Valorant roster. Reserved for the competitive squad, VOD review to follow.

events.title: Dota 2 Draft Theory Session

events.title: Members LAN Social

events.title: LCK Summer Invitational — Watch Party
